kind: TMP genuine new regular-boundary-only Nagumo invariance component handoff; no official registration
precise_mathematical_scope: For a complete real normed space, an open domain D, a locally Lipschitz autonomous F and C1 h on D, true existing paths on Icc a b with actual right ODE derivatives and initial h>=0 stay h>=0, provided fderiv h is nonzero and fderiv h(F)>=0 at every zero in D.

Only zeros require the weak inward inequality. No C1 vector field, Lipschitz gradient, global Lipschitz bound, supplied solution limit, invariant-set premise, or forward-completeness conclusion is assumed.

Regularity gives a fixed positive differential direction near each boundary encounter. Uniform Picard perturbations F+epsilon*v are safe by strict scalar fencing, and the actual Gronwall bound tends to zero, deriving local weak safety of the original existing path.
Time translation plus continuous induction propagates derived local safety through the whole existing compact time interval, including endpoints.

Every actual ForwardSolution satisfies the derived IsForwardInvariant predicate. In finite dimension, if the entire safe superlevel set is compact and contained in D, the earlier genuine maximal-existence and compact-continuation results derive actual global safe solutions from every safe initial state.
